We used the crowdannotation platform of Appen.  We employed three crowd-raters per post, all of whom were warned for explicit content. Raters were selected from the smallest group of the most experienced and accurate contributors.
guideline: We asked crowd annotators to highlight the spans that constitute 'anything that is rude, disrespectful, or unreasonable that would make someone want to leave a conversation'. Besides toxicity our annotators were also asked to select a subtype for each highlighted span, choosing between insult, threat, identity-based attack, profane/obscene, or other toxicity.
